candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108) (c. 100 BC)

'Fear ye not the sinners, ye righteous; for again will the Lord deliver them into your hands, that ye may execute judgement upon them according to your desires' — the righteous shall judge the wicked. Direct verbal anticipation of 1 Cor 6:2 ('Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world?') and Rev 20:4 (thrones of judgment given to the saints). Tewahedo eschatology preserves this saints-judge-the-world expectation as part of the broader theosis-and-vindication theology.

Verify the summary still reflects the source's argument before promoting; substitute a verbatim quote from the NPNF / Charles dump where available, and where applicable cross-check the Andəmta homiletic tradition for resonance.
